issue.title: Temporary: verify dynamic Markdown fence rendering
issue.creation_body_exact:
Temporary GitHub Markdown rendering experiment for `sarif-to-comment`.

Expected: the section below renders as one code block whose text exactly matches the proposed Markdown file, including the triple-backtick example and the fourteen-backtick line.

```````````````
# Proposed guide

Here is a TypeScript example:

```ts
const fence = "```";
```

A deliberately long fence follows:

``````````````
literal after the long fence
```````````````

This issue will be closed after rendered readback.
